reviewer: Independent GATE fixed-one-hour synthetic bridge review
acceptance_scope: The exact new delayed bridge and optional availability-cutoff extension, on synthetic inputs through the unchanged accepted ledger. No complete comparative experiment/harness, historical returns, prospective dates/horizon, metadata mapper, statistical validation or operations are accepted.

assessments.classification: SHOWN source and focused synthetic tests
assessments.subject: Information end T versus receipt/fill E
assessments.detail: The receipt panel keeps the parent window ending at T but passes E=T+H as available_by_ms. No intervening row is added to the 300-bar feature window, original receipts are copied rather than rewritten, and a final receipt after E fails. The optional keyword defaults to the original cutoff and rejects a cutoff before window end. Exact/1ms/half-hour/full-hour tests and after-cutoff refusal passed.

assessments.classification: SHOWN source and focused synthetic tests
assessments.subject: Wallet/marks and execution prices
assessments.detail: Actual ledger pre-fill cash/units at E are retained, while the strategy target NAV is recomputed using T's close marks. The later context marked_nav is replaced, not used for sizing. The ledger still prices/settles the pending target at E's execution open under its joint post-cost/rounding rules. This is explicitly delayed-signal target formation with the current wallet, not a claim to quantities frozen at T or a new allocator.

assessments.classification: SHOWN source and focused synthetic tests
assessments.subject: Separate permission clocks and exclusions
assessments.detail: Signal permission is selected as known/effective at T; the unchanged ledger selects execution permission known/applicable at E. An intervening disable excludes the entry, while permission only learned after T cannot retroactively establish the signal. Flat known-ineligible assets do not require candles. Incumbent active requirements are its pair plus actual holdings, not unrelated universe labels. Exhaustion and missing-open expiry remain explicit; no intent is latched.

assessments.classification: SHOWN source and focused synthetic tests
assessments.subject: Ex-post outcomes versus causal features
assessments.detail: Current completed outcome-frame prices are validated against exact raw rows even if those outcome rows arrived later. They validate the modelled valuation/fill path rather than become signal features or T marks. The binding includes closed-prefix outcome rows regardless of receipt availability, preventing later rewriting of already-used outcome prices. Conflicting/missing outcomes invalidate the case; no late outcome availability is represented as decision-time knowledge.

assessments.classification: SHOWN source reuse and focused synthetic tests
assessments.subject: Parent formula, traces and carry
assessments.detail: The accepted parent's actual frozen-family logic and incumbent formula are reused at signal close T. Sunday-candle targets fill Monday 01:00 UTC in the synthetic fixture, with no extra incumbent rebalances. Trace scheduling time is intentionally the ledger frame reference; strategy_signal_bar_ts_ms, signal_close_ms, receipt_cutoff_ms and model_execution_ms retain the older strategy clock. Primary financial fills are not rewritten. Identity includes delay/allocation/permission conventions; full-versus-split state/trade equality and historical-receipt/profile-switch refusals passed.

assessments.classification: SHOWN source preservation and synthetic compatibility
assessments.subject: Original API and controls boundary
assessments.detail: The original bridge's only change is the optional available_by_ms keyword and corresponding receipt/listing cutoff comparisons. Reversing precisely those edits yields the accepted 86825d...c4acf source hash. Ledger/snapshot/default tests match their bound hashes. The synthetic control test uses the same supplied initial E and final marked close without rebasing capital. This is endpoint compatibility evidence, not a full comparative harness or permission to invent a prospective activation/horizon.

verification.environment: VERIFIED_ENV isolated repository Python, local hash/string comparisons and synthetic fixtures only
verification.command: env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 ./.venv/bin/python -B -m pytest --noconftest -c /dev/null -p no:cacheprovider -q tests/test_delayed_signal_bridge.py tests/test_frozen_signal_bridge.py tests/test_shared_cash_research.py tests/test_next_open_research.py tests/test_harness_contracts_wp4.py
verification.cases: 28 new delayed cases plus 129 existing synthetic/accounting/compatibility cases
verification.reversal_scope: Signature addition, cutoff initialization/validation and two availability/listing comparisons only; no source written during reversal.

retained_limits: One hour is a fixed modelling allowance, not measured arrival latency, a processing-time margin or assurance of filling the boundary open.
Target formation uses actual pre-fill E holdings/cash valued at older T close marks. It is not a frozen T-quantity order; that distinction must remain in later experiment descriptions.
Ex-post consistency checks may invalidate an entire path after diagnostic fills/equity entries exist. INCOMPLETE/unknown profit must never be promoted into a valid observed execution result.

Only present raw outcome prices are compared; none is invented for a missing execution open. Existing valuation/exclusion/expiry semantics remain, and missing required signal marks still invalidate the path.
The source reuses the accepted event policy and joint ledger; acceptance is not a renewed exhaustive financial/strategy/SDK/runtime audit.

A mechanical cash-only control following a failed intended benchmark entry is not a valid benchmark comparison. The future comparison-level gate is explicitly absent and remains required before a market experiment.
The library adds no prospective dates/horizon. Initial cash-only interval, activation A, first fill E and endpoint B must be aligned explicitly in any future authorized registration.
Costs/capital/quote rounding/status sampling/freshness/minimum mapping and inference choices remain outside this timing implementation acceptance.

One venue/common quote/no FX or yield and hypothetical full fills at caller-supplied costs/precision remain the two model premises. Historical eligibility, execution capacity, liquidity, strategy economics and profitability remain UNVERIFIED.
Test guards operate in test bodies, not as a universal imported-module safety proof. No market dataset or operational interface was exercised.

read_scope.narrow_existing_source: HourlyPanel.window optional keyword/cutoff and parent reuse interface, with exact in-memory reverse to the accepted source digest. No old ledger/design/runtime/SDK review reopened.
read_scope.hash_only: All 11 bound input files and the two additional requested compatibility test files are listed in hashes.reviewed_inputs.
read_scope.tests: The specified five-file slice ran once; no extra probe or broad matrix. Existing incumbent test compiles only the frozen target() AST, not a study/data-loader body.

next_boundary: Parent may close the bounded synthetic implementation stage against these hashes. Further comparative harness work, metadata/protocol choices, calibration, data collection or experiment execution needs its own explicit scope/authorization; none is initiated or granted here.
